info.title: xTIPP REST API
info.description:
Stateless REST API of the tippgame xTIPP.

**Authentication:** create your API key on the page `/api-schluessel` (one key per user) and send it in every request as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. There is no session and no username/password. In this documentation click **Authorize** and paste the key, then use **Try it out**. Revoke, regenerate or delete the key on the key page at any time.

**Basics:** all answers are JSON. Successful answers have the content in `data`. Errors have a `message` (and `errors` for invalid input). Limit: {rate_limit} requests per minute and key (set by the administrator).

**HTTPS:** by default, calls over plain HTTP answer with 403 and the key is not processed (the administrator can disable this). If you sent your key over HTTP, regenerate it.

**Like the website:** only the leagues made available by the administrator can be used, and an endpoint answers with 403 when the administrator has hidden the matching page of the website (e.g. tipping, bonus, tip overview, ranking).

**Where to start:** `GET /leagues` → `GET /leagues/{league}/seasons` → `GET /seasons/{season}/matchdays` → the other calls.

get.description: All leagues which the administrator made available, sorted by name. The league id is needed for seasons and the all-time ranking. Leagues, seasons and games of other leagues answer with 404.

get.summary: List the seasons of a league
List the matchdays and rounds of a season
get.description: The `key` of an entry is the identifier of the matchday in all further calls. It is the same list as in the tip page of the website. `current` marks the matchday the website shows by default.

get.summary: Get a matchday or round with its games

parameters.name: matchday
parameters.description: Key of a matchday or round of the season (see `GET /seasons/{season}/matchdays`), for example `matchday_5` or `round_12-13`.

get.summary: Get your own tips of a matchday or round
get.description: Every game with your tip (`null` if you did not tip). `points` of a tip is `null` as long as the game has not started.

parameters.name: matchday
parameters.description: Key of a matchday or round of the season (see `GET /seasons/{season}/matchdays`), for example `matchday_5` or `round_12-13`.

get.summary: Get the tip overview of a matchday or round
get.description: Per game your own tip, the tips of all other users and the distribution of the tips. Like on the website, **the tips of other users are only visible when the deadline of the game is reached** (`tips_visible`), before that `tips` is empty. `allocation` is `null` if the website would not show it (setting of the administrator).

parameters.name: matchday
parameters.description: Key of a matchday or round of the season (see `GET /seasons/{season}/matchdays`), for example `matchday_5` or `round_12-13`.

get.summary: Get the single ranking of a season
get.description: Without parameters the whole season. With `from` and/or `to` (keys of the matchday list) only the matchdays/rounds in between, with the same meaning as in the ranking page of the website. Users with equal values share a place; the next place is skipped (1, 1, 3).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Key of the first matchday or round, default: the first of the season.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Key of the last matchday or round, default: the last of the season.

get.summary: Get the all-time ranking of a league
get.description: The sums over all seasons of the league.

put.summary: Create or change your tip of a game
put.description: Creates the tip, or replaces it if there is one already, so the call can be repeated safely. Both goals `null` delete the tip. The same rules as on the website apply: deadline of the game, and no draw for knockout games when the result after extra time counts.

409.description: The deadline of the game is reached or the game has started, the tip can not be changed anymore.

423.description: The data are being synchronized, try again in a moment.

delete.summary: Delete your tip of a game
delete.description: Removes your tip. Does nothing if there is none.

409.description: The deadline of the game is reached or the game has started, the tip can not be changed anymore.

423.description: The data are being synchronized, try again in a moment.

get.summary: Bonus questions of a season with your answers
get.description: All bonus questions of the season, sorted by question like on the website, with your answers. Needs the page "Bonus" (`/tippen/bonus`).

get.summary: One bonus question with your answers

get.description: Like the selection on the website: the teams of the round of the question, otherwise the teams of the season. For a question of type `club` the `id` is the answer. For a question of type `player` use the `id` with `GET /bonus-questions/{bonus}/players` to find the players.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Only names which contain this text.

get.summary: Players of a club which can be chosen
get.description: Only for questions of type `player` (otherwise `404`). The `id` of a player is the answer.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Only names which contain this text.

200.description: Current players of the club, sorted by last name

put.summary: Set your answers of a bonus question
put.description:
The list replaces all your answers of the question, so the call can be repeated safely. To add an answer, send the given answers together with the new one; to change or remove one, send the list without it. An empty list deletes all answers.

An answer is the id of a club (type `club`) or of a player (type `player`), see the calls `clubs` and `players`. Not more than `possible_answers`, each only once.

**Points:** the points depend on the time of the answer (see `points` of the question). Like on the website, an answer which you have given already is kept with its time, also when it is sent again.

409.description: The deadline of the bonus question is reached, the answers can not be changed anymore.

423.description: The data are being synchronized, try again in a moment.

delete.summary: Delete your answers of a bonus question
delete.description: Removes all your answers of the question. Does nothing if there are none.

409.description: The deadline of the bonus question is reached, the answers can not be changed anymore.

423.description: The data are being synchronized, try again in a moment.

has_table.description: The matchday is part of a round with a league table.

placeholder.description: Shown as long as the team is not known (for example `Winner of game 3`).

result.description: The result which counts for the points (depends on the setting for the playing time). `null` as long as the game has not started.

deadline_reached.description: `true`: the tip can not be changed anymore.

points.description: `null` as long as the game has not started.

tips_visible.description: `true` when the deadline of the game is reached and the tips of the other users are listed.

tips.description: Tips of the other users, sorted by name. Empty as long as `tips_visible` is `false`.

difference.description: Tips with the right goal difference

current_matchday_points.description: Points of the user at the last played matchday/round of the selection (`from`/`to`), like the column "+" of the website. `null`, if no game of the selection has been played.

place_change.description: Change of the place by the last played matchday/round of the selection: positive = places gained, negative = places lost. `null`, if nothing was played before this matchday or the user was not in the ranking before.

answer.description: Id of the club or of the player, the value for `PUT .../answers`.

club.description: The club (type `club`), or the current club of the player (national team in a league of national teams). `null` if unknown.

points.description: Points of this answer. `null` as long as the administrator has not entered the correct answers.

updated_at.description: Time of the answer, it decides the points.

type.description: `club`: the answer is a club/country. `player`: the answer is a player.

possible_answers.description: How many answers can be given.

end.description: End of the question as shown on the website.

points.description: Points for a correct answer, depending on the time of the answer: an answer given before `until` gets `points` (the first entry which fits counts). Answers are possible until the last `until`.

deadline_reached.description: `true`: the answers can not be changed anymore.

answers.description: Ids of clubs or players, at most `possible_answers`. Empty deletes all answers.

message.example: The home goals field must be present.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing, unknown, revoked or expired, or the user is not active.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests ({rate_limit} per minute and key) or too many failed attempts.

Forbidden.description: The function is disabled on this website (the administrator has hidden the matching page, e.g. the tip overview or the all-time ranking).

ServiceUnavailable.description: The website is in maintenance mode (JSON, only admins can continue), or xTIPP cannot reach its database. In the second case xTIPP answers before the API with a plain HTML page and `Retry-After: 60`.

Retry-After.description: Only when the database is not available.
